command: server="${PEN_MCP_SERVER:-}"; if [ -z "$server" ] && command -v mdfind >/dev/null 2>&1; then app="$(mdfind "kMDItemFSName == 'Pen.app'" | head -n 1)"; for candidate in "$app"/Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/out/mcp-server-*; do if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then server="$candidate"; break; fi; done; fi; [ -x "$server" ] || { printf '%s\n' 'Unable to locate the Pen MCP server.' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$server" "$@"
